title: Handling Share on Parking License Reinstatement Measured on the Latest Payment
content:
Collections note, Parking License: the reinstatement fee carries a handling share measured on the most recent payment received on the license.

## Note

When the most recent payment received on the license is at least 2 times the monthly fee in force, the fee carries a handling share of 0.05 times that payment; when it is at least 1 times but less than 2 times the monthly fee in force, the handling share is 0.03 times that payment; in every other case there is no handling share. The handling share is added to the reinstatement fee and is carried unrounded until the fee is rounded.

- **Most recent payment received:** the latest payment line on the license's parking ledger, by the date it was received.
- **Monthly fee in force:** the monthly license fee recorded on the license.

## Share by size of the latest payment

| Latest payment against the monthly fee in force | Handling share |
|---|---|
| 2 times the fee or more | 0.05 (5%) of that payment |
| at least 1 times, less than 2 times the fee | 0.03 (3%) of that payment |
| less than 1 times the fee, or no payment on the license | none |

## Worked examples (hypothetical monthly fee in force of $95.00)

| Latest payment | Against $95.00 | Handling share |
|---|---|---|
| $190.00 | exactly 2 times | 0.05 multiplied by $190.00, $9.50 |
| $189.99 | less than 2 times, at least 1 time | 0.03 multiplied by $189.99, $5.6997 |
| $95.00 | exactly 1 time | 0.03 multiplied by $95.00, $2.85 |
| $94.99 | less than 1 time | none |
